config.multiplier.name: Base price multiplier
config.multiplier.tooltip: Multiplies the price of every backpack upgrade (24, 36, 48, 60 and 72 slots). Base prices: 2,000g / 10,000g / 50,000g / 100,000g / 250,000g.
config.arrows.name: Show scroll arrows
config.rownumbers.name: Show row numbers
config.shift.enable.name: Enable row shifting keys
config.shift.enable.tooltip: Shift Row Down brings the next backpack row onto the toolbar; Shift Row Up brings the previous row back.
config.shift.down.name: Shift Row Down
config.shift.down.tooltip: Moves the next backpack row onto the toolbar.
config.shift.up.name: Shift Row Up
config.shift.up.tooltip: Moves the previous backpack row onto the toolbar.
config.shift.cycle.name: Rows in the shift cycle
config.shift.cycle.tooltip: How many rows (counting from the toolbar row) take part in shifting. 'All rows' uses every row you own.
